verdict.summary: The success-path probe is fail-soft, uses the same resolved forge token as release-plz, cannot create a pull request because head and base are identical, and only treats the established 422 response as evidence that authorization passed. Other statuses remain inconclusive or blocked, so transient curl/API failures cannot produce a false promotion signal. The registry and release documentation accurately describe the workflow behavior. No correctness, security, or test-validity issue is apparent in this scoped workflow/documentation change.
